04 / The people behind the work

Two directors.
One connected approach.

You’ll speak with the people responsible for your project. Dipesh and Manjil stay directly involved, connecting the client experience, company operations and practical work on site.

LifeBuild Canada’s construction experience is part of Terranode’s next chapter. The way we work is personal: clear conversations, considered decisions and a shared view of what comes next.

Technical + construction + delivery

Manjil

Director / Terranode

Clarity in the plans.
Confidence in the work.

Manjil leads technical scope and construction delivery, bringing estimating, scheduling, trade coordination and work on site into one practical plan. He connects the higher-level construction decisions with the detail needed to execute them.

Directly involved in technical planning, site coordination and progress.

Brand + operations + client experience

Dipesh

Director / Terranode

A personal connection.
A considered experience.

Dipesh connects your priorities with the people, sourcing and decisions that move the project forward. He leads the client experience, company operations and brand presence, keeping communication, service and day-to-day project management coordinated.

Directly involved from the first conversation through sourcing, coordination and follow-through.

We review project fit and commitments together. As work develops, you have two directly involved directors, complementary perspectives and a clear next step.

06 / A simple beginning

From an idea
to a conversation.

You don’t need all the answers.
We’ll start with what matters to you.

  1. Tell us about your space.

    Share your idea, its location and the best way to reach you. Early thoughts are welcome.

  2. Talk through what matters.

    We review your enquiry and connect to discuss priorities, possibilities and project fit.

  3. Make the next step clear.

    If we’re a fit, we outline a path forward together, with scope and expectations made clear.
